declarations.name: VsaDial
declarations.summary: A dial is a ring that shows progress, in a deep carved channel with a raised center.

members.name: value
members.description: The current value, from 0 to max.

members.name: max
members.description: The value of a full ring.

members.name: label
members.description: The accessible name. Screen readers read it with the value. Without it, the dial uses its center text, or "Progress", and warns in the console.

members.name: size
members.description: The size and the depth. The small dial (s) has a shallow carve, for lists and table rows. The large dial (l) is for the main number of a page. All sizes follow the font size.

slots.description: The center content, for example a number or an icon. If it is empty, the medium dial shows the percent.

cssParts.name: indicator
cssParts.description: The colored ring that shows the value.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The container of the center content.

cssProperties.name: --track-width
cssProperties.description: The width of the colored ring.

cssProperties.name: --track-color
cssProperties.description: The color of the carved channel.

cssProperties.name: --indicator-color
cssProperties.description: The color of the ring that shows the value. variant sets it to a status color.

declarations.name: VsaTable
declarations.summary: A table wrapper that shows each row as a block in a narrow container. Each cell then shows its column header above its value.

members.name: stackWidth
members.description: The width of the element, in px, below which each row shows as a block.

members.name: stacked
members.description: True when the rows show as blocks.

slots.description: One native <table>, with its column headers in <thead>.

cssStates.name: stacked
cssStates.description: The element is narrower than stack-width, and each row shows as a block.
